I have many more logs but I don't know why it always cut the time off when the loop stopped executing.  I have go back to version 3.0.0.1 now as I had this happening many times at day and night.  In particular one night it didn't execute fir 30 min . Basal was 1.0 u per hour and bg was dropping.  I'm.not sure why this is not happening in ver 3.0 but returned in ver 3.1

BG is changing I don't know why this is happening. Its the same problem I
had in all previous versions.  I will update tomorrow to 3.1 and I make
sure I have pictures and logs have right times.
